items.title: Fed's rate hike push may be a mistake. Here's why
items.summary: Experts argue that the Fed is looking at the wrong data as it pushes for more interest-rate hikes, with falling gasoline and energy prices suggesting inflation pressures are already easing.

items.title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
items.summary: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

items.title: Bitcoin miner that sold its last BTC warns it may run short of cash for $1.2 billion AI deal
items.summary: Hyperscale Data needs another $74.8 million to complete its Michigan data center project, even after selling its remaining bitcoin and raising fresh debt.

items.title: CZ says tokenized Anthropic is coming to BNB Chain on IPO day
items.summary: Changpeng Zhao says Anthropic-linked tokens from bStocks, Ondo and xStocks will hit BNB Chain on day one of the AI giant’s Nasdaq debut. This follows a $500 million pre-IPO rush that comes with notable fine print.

items.title: Another U.S. appellate court goes against Kalshi, building the industry's legal headwinds
items.summary: Despite a Commodity Futures Trading Commission demand that prediction markets return to operating in all 50 states, federal courts continue to get in the way.

items.title: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is buying its CEO’s venture capital business, Tribe
items.summary: Sethi, who was appointed co-CEO of Kraken in October 2024, is also the chairman of Tribe Capital.

items.title: A $1.5 billion crypto startup is taking on Hyperliquid with a Wall Street playbook
items.summary: Variational and its investors are betting that the future of onchain trading will look more like a traditional brokerage than a crypto exchange.

items.title: Crypto Long &amp; Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
items.summary: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as tradi

items.title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin
items.summary: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.

items.title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
items.summary: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.

items.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
items.summary: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

items.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
items.summary: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.

items.title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
items.summary: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.

items.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
items.summary: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

items.title: Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.

items.title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
items.summary: Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight
items.summary: The lawmakers urged Treasury to extend safe harbor protections to stablecoin issuers in states expected to establish qualifying regulatory frameworks before January 2028.

items.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
items.summary: Stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen, while the hackers also took memecoins, tokenized gold and gaming tokens.

items.title: GameStop CEO Says Digital-Only Games Have ‘Hurt Consumers’ as GTA 6 Skips Discs
items.summary: Ryan Cohen said publishers are cutting out trade-ins, as he backs a U.S. bill that would guarantee gamers keep access to games they buy.

items.title: Bitcoin Struggles to Hold $64,000 as ETF Outflows Hit $2.9B in November
items.summary: Bitcoin is down 13% in a week as investors pull money from spot ETFs and brace for another Federal Reserve rate hike.

items.title: Ledger Confirms Tampered Bitcoin Wallets in Berlin as Spy Implant Probe Spreads Beyond Asia
items.summary: Ledger says its hardware implant investigation has confirmed tampered devices in Berlin and is examining two suspected units in Dubai, as the incident spreads beyond Southeast Asia.

items.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
items.summary: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.

items.title: Palmer Luckey Says He’s Building an Offshore Haven for Industry—And 'Illegal' Medicine
items.summary: The Oculus founder says his decade-old SLAB project aims to escape state restrictions on manufacturing and medical treatment.

items.title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time
items.summary: Google's Genie 4 lets Ultra subscribers reshape interactive scenes while exploring them, complete with sound and dialogue, as Project Genie adds longer sessions and new community creation and sharing tools.

items.title: Why CoinShares Just Sold All Its Ethereum and Half Its Solana
items.summary: The crypto asset manager sold $16.6 million in Ethereum and $2.7 million in Solana, freeing up $19.3 million. Here's why.

items.title: Bitcoin Tanks Ahead of Anthropic’s IPO. Should We Really Blame AI?
items.summary: Bitcoin slid toward $63,000 as Anthropic prepared its blockbuster debut. Analysts dispute whether the IPO is draining crypto liquidity, pointing instead to ETF outflows, forced selling and rising interest rates.

items.title: Bitcoin Miners Are Selling Their Stacks to Fund the AI Boom
items.summary: MARA sold 13,597 BTC after September and Riot sold 20,264 BTC through September to fund debt repayment and AI data center buildouts, as Glassnode flagged the pair as the main sellers among Bitcoin treasury firms.

items.title: Fed's Waller Calls for 50-Basis-Point Rate Hike, Says Tokenized Finance Still Needs Traditional Banks
